query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.empresaNome, ar.valorOriginal, ar.valorLiquido, ar.vencimentoData, ar.tipo, ar.formaCobranca, ar.centroDeCustosId, ca.status as cobrancaStatus FROM accounts_receivable ar LEFT JOIN collection_actions ca ON ar.id = ca.receivableId WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < '2026-05-14' ORDER BY ar.vencimentoData ASC LIMIT 5;
